scenario_description:
Objective: Secure the store’s resin-safe black-primer preparation for Theo’s selected March 6 OSL-clinic centerpiece before its allocation closes.
Emerging Need: The confirmed clinic requires a dry black-primed model, and the project record establishes that the selected assembled, washed resin model is unprimed and has no black primer at home.
Decision Context: Once the compressor test passes, the record supports requesting an eligible March 4 bench slot rather than treating generic preparation advice as completed work.
Consequence: Missing Friday 17:00 closes this store-provided preparation route; other safe arrangements may still be explored, so loss of a bench slot is not proof that all clinic participation is impossible.

parameter.title: Isthmus OSL clinic
parameter.description: Hands-on object-source-lighting clinic; bring one assembled centerpiece model. Final surface-prep details to follow from the organizer.

parameter.subject: OSL clinic prep sheet: black primer requirement
parameter.body: Prep sheet for the March 6 clinic: each attendee needs one fully dry, black-primed centerpiece model for the lighting steps. Grey primer will not read correctly under the demo lamps. The shop may open a resin-safe airbrush primer bench after the compressor test posts Thursday; please do not request a bench slot before that notice.

parameter.content: Clinic prep update: the compressor test passed, so the resin-safe black primer bench is open for two Wednesday evening slots on March 4. Holds are by message until Friday at 17:00, and the bench is only for models that are already assembled and washed.

parameter.subject: Primer bench closed for OSL clinic prep
parameter.body: The March 4 black-primer bench allocation is now closed and both slots are assigned. There will be no walk-up priming at the clinic, and wet primer cannot be used at the Friday lighting tables.
